item.title: Video report – ‘I want to feel alive’: how AI revived Dilara’s message after Monaco tragedy
item.description: A powerful AI-generated video brings back the voice of 19-year-old Dilara Akhundova, killed in a 2023 Monaco crash, to deliver a haunting message on road safety and finish the art she left behind.

item.title: Cocteau’s spirit guides surrealist exhibition at Villefranche-sur-Mer in summer 2026
item.description: L'Absurde et le Rêve will open in summer 2026, featuring monumental outdoor installations and intimate interior works exploring surrealism and humanity's disconnection from nature.

item.title: Football: Monaco record first Ligue 1 win since November
item.description: AS Monaco ran riot against Stade Rennais (4-0) as Sébastien Pocogonoli's side secured all three points in Ligue 1 for the first time since the end of November.

item.title: 5,000 students engaged in Cinema for Change festival
item.description: Nearly 400 schoolchildren from Monaco packed the Théâtre des Variétés on Thursday to watch and vote for their favourite short films addressing global development challenges.

item.title: Salvador Dalí comes to Mareterra: Inside Monaco’s newest art destination
item.description: Step inside the Dalí Universe at Mareterra's new gallery space - a major coup for the Principality showcasing works from the world's largest Dalí sculpture collection, curated by the artist's close friend.

item.title: ‘Long Live the Queen!’: Nice Carnival ditches its Kings for a Queen
item.description: For 153 years, Nice's Carnival has predominantly featured male monarchs and masculine themes. But this year the carnival is staging a royal revolution.

item.title: Roca Team extend winning streak with victory against Le Portel
item.description: AS Monaco Basketball recorded their ninth straight win in France's top basketball division, with their 113-86 victory against Le Portel on Sunday.

item.title: How will superyachts meet 2035 environmental standards? Monaco gathers industry to find answers
item.description: The annual gathering on Wednesday, 5th February will bring together yacht owners, shipyards, designers and maritime experts to discuss how the sector is adapting to new environmental standards by 2035.

item.title: Prince Albert II visits northern Italy to strengthen historical ties
item.description: Prince Albert II has completed a two-day visit to northern Italy, formally recognising two historic towns' connections to the Grimaldi Heritage.

item.title: Outward Bound Monaco launches summer adventure programmes with early booking discount
item.description: Monaco-based families have a limited time to secure an early bird discount on summer adventure programmes offering young people outdoor challenges in some of Britain's most dramatic landscapes.
